nodes.label: Vendors and contracts register (EN)
nodes.rationale: Vendors and contracts page. KPI strip (active contracts 25, ending within 30 days 1, ended 11, vendors 25, cost centres 7), filter chips for Contracts, Vendors and Cost centres, and a table sorted soonest end first. Filters are search, kind, ending within and ended only. Each row shows vendor, end date, notice-by date, days-left badge, annual cost (50,000 SAR), covered assets count and a signed-agreement link. Capture is filtered on en-1793990932054.

nodes.label: Contract notice-by date and renewal window
nodes.rationale: Each contract carries a notice-by date ahead of its end date, plus a days-left badge, and the register sorts soonest end first. Renewal decisions need the notice deadline visible, not only the end date.
